content.comment_body: Hello. I recently built a project with 30 push buttons on a custom web server page. Each button is assigned a corresponding tag based on my configuration. Most buttons monitor memory blocks, which appear correctly in the variable menu, but the push button animation sometimes shows some memory blocks as having a 0 value. This issue occurs on my computer (Windows, tested with several browsers), while on my phone, more buttons seem to work correctly—though not all. Since I see more variables on the phone, I don't think it's a programming error. Could this be a server limitation?

Hi [user_name], From what I know, there are 64 flags available, unless they are used elsewhere. However, this system can't be fully compared to a proper web server, and the editor may retain old data even if deleted, which can create issues. Along with encryption, this can slow down transmission and may cause packet loss. Remember, the device needs to process its program as well as provide the website. Try connecting through the variable bytes and their bits (VB) instead of markers. Best regards, [user_name] (translated via Google)
Can you upload your project and web editor files as a ZIP archive?

analysis.insight_summary: The user observes inconsistent behavior with push button status visualization between Windows computers and mobile devices on a custom web server page set up using [product_name] software. These inconsistencies suggest possible server or platform limitations, especially related to handling multiple monitored variables and rendering animation updates in real time.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects all push button elements to display and update correctly and consistently on both computer and mobile devices, with accurate real-time status on the web server custom page.
